dedupe_keys.name: domestic waste emissions to european freshwaters in the 2010s jrc ccm2 catchments and nuts3

description: This dataset estimates mean annual domestic waste emissions to Europe's freshwater network in the 2010s, as population equivalents and loads of total nitrogen, total phosphorus and five-day biochemical oxygen demand, split by emission pathway. It combines available European databases with population density and national statistics, aggregated to CCM 2.1 elementary catchments and to NUTS 3 regions. The European Commission's Joint Research Centre produced it and offers it as a free download from the JRC Data Catalogue as a file geodatabase and CSV under the Commission's reuse notice, with a Scientific Data descriptor (2020). Coverage is continental for Europe, for 2014-2015. Caveats: point-source locations carry uncertainty, which is why loads are aggregated by catchment, and the figures are modelled estimates. Simulation uses: pollution load baselines for planning wastewater treatment capacity and for exposure and adaptation studies of receiving waters. Related records: the UWWTD treatment plant data (data-uwwtd-treatment-plants), the SFI European WWTP database (data-sfi-municipal-wwtp-database-europe) and Eurostat's population connected to treatment (data-eurostat-population-connected-wastewater-treatment).
